name: Ritz Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes
insider_take: This isn't just another Orlando hotel – it's a palatial escape where luxury meets the magic of Central Florida, complete with its own 18-hole Greg Norman championship golf course and a world-class spa inspired by ancient apothecary traditions.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton sits on 500 pristine acres at Grande Lakes, featuring the only Ritz-Carlton spa in Florida with a unique outdoor vitality pool. The property boasts Florida's first Ritz-Carlton Club Level with dedicated concierge service, and houses Normans restaurant – the only Greg Norman signature dining experience in North America.
pro_tip: Book a sunset falconry experience on the golf course – it's one of only a few hotels worldwide offering this ancient sport, and you'll get incredible photos with birds of prey against Orlando's skyline.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive eco-adventures through the 40-acre Shingle Creek nature preserve, where you can kayak the headwaters of the Everglades. Also, the property features the largest hotel lazy river in Orlando at 4,000 square feet, winding through lush tropical landscaping.
pros: Luxury Ritz-Carlton service and amenities with championship golf course
Premium Orlando location with easy Disney World access
Full-service spa and multiple dining venues on-site
Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits and upgrades
cons: Large resort property may require walking or shuttle transport
